Name: Tree Overhaul - A Tappers Dream
Author: Goldenrevolver
Description:
[size=3][color=#93c47d]Do you want tapper and mushroom box products to have quality? For that and many other foraging features, check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7554/]Forage Fantasy[/url]﻿!

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.3 and SMAPI 4.0.6. Source available on Github:
[/color][url=https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods]https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods[/url]
If you want to buy me coffee, I now have a [url=https://ko-fi.com/goldenrevolver]ko-fi[/url].


Are you tired of getting stuck on saplings that grow in the shade of your perfect tree farm?
Do you just want to farm the seeds but they are constantly growing so you can't pick them up anymore?
Do you want your normal and mushroom trees to grow alongside your fruit trees in the winter?

Then fear no more, tapper or lumberjack. I present to you the Tree Overhaul!

Many configurable options for your trusty trees:


[b]Tree seeds don't grow in the shade of a grown tree (the 8 surrounding tiles):[/b]
So you can walk over them and collect them (default: true). If you don't want them to spawn at all, there is a feature for that below too.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/260-0-1459813189.gif[/img]
Comparison after clearing the farm on the 1st of summer then leaving it grow until the 28th of summer with or without the mod installed.


[b]Normal trees grow in winter even without fertilizer:[/b]
Why should fruit trees be the only ones! (default: true)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/260-0-1459813150.gif[/img]
Example growth change pictures are on 1st, 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th of winter.


[b]Mushroom trees grow in winter:[/b]
Why should they simply die every winter and magically revive in the spring? (default: false)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/260-0-1459813171.gif[/img]


[b]Small tree stumps don't block other tree growth:[/b]
In the base game, even the stump of a chopped down fully grown tree prevents other trees from growing. This feature makes it so trees ignore small tree stumps when checking for obstacles that block their growth (default: true).

[b]Fully grown fruit trees block other normal tree growth:[/b]
In the base game, a normal tree can grow right next to a fully grown fruit tree while a fruit tree cannot grow right next to a fully grown normal tree. This feature makes it so normal trees don't ignore fully grown fruit trees when checking for obstacles that block their growth (default: true).


[b]Save saplings from hoes, pickaxes and weapons:[/b]
Sprouted saplings (including fruit trees) are safe from hoe, pickaxe and optionally also scythe and melee weapons. Now you can remove weeds or harvest seeds with an upgraded hoe without destroying the saplings next to them! Choose one of the following numbers:
0: Disabled (default)
1: Saves normal and fruit tree sprouts from hoes and pickaxes.
2: Additionally saves normal sprouts from scythes (fruit trees are immune to weapons by default). Use this option if you clear out weeds with a scythe anyway and don't want the mod to try and save sprouts when you are using your sword in the mines.
3: Additionally saves normal sprouts from all melee weapons, including their secondary attacks (fruit trees are immune to weapons by default).
(Done by Request from Freshairkaboom and YumeMiru)


[b]Buffed mahogany trees[/b]:
In the base game they only have a 15% chance to grow normally and 60% with fertilizer. This removes the unneeded nerf and makes the chances 20% and 100% respectively like for all other trees. (default: false). The same features also exists for the new 1.6 spoiler tree.


[b]Adjustable chance for trees to grow:
[/b]You can change the base game chance of 15-20% to as low as 0% or as high as 100%!
Setting it to -1 reverts all trees to their default behavior. (default: -1, chance depends on the host in multiplayer)

[b]Adjustable chance that fully grown trees spawn planted seeds nearby:[/b]
You can change the base game chance of 15% to as low as 0% or as high as 100%!
Setting it to -1 reverts all trees to their default behavior (default: -1, chance depends on the host in multiplayer).

[b]Adjustable chance for seeds to drop when shaking a tree:
[/b]You can change the base game chance of 5-15% to as low as 0% or as high as 100%!
Setting it to -1 reverts all trees to their default behavior (default: -1, chance depends on the host in multiplayer).

[b]Adjustable chance for seeds to drop when chopping down a tree:[/b]
You can change the base game chance of 56-75% to as low as 0% or as high as 100%!
Setting it to -1 reverts all trees to their default behavior (default: -1, chance depends on the host in multiplayer).


[b]Requirements:[/b]
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]: I built version 4.0.2 of this mod based on version 4.0.6. It should be compatible with a few future versions and a few prior version. You can get the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].


[b]Installation:[/b]
Install SMAPI. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder, change the config file inside the mod and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam.

You can also optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the config ingame without the need to restart (otherwise you need to restart) but it is not required to be installed.


[b]Updating: [/b]
Simply delete the prior version, install the new one and check the updated config created after the first startup (Changes require restart to take effect if you have not made them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).


[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
You can delete this mod from your mods folder at any time to remove the features without losing any trees or other issues like in some similar mods. If you are in winter, mushroom trees will revert to stumps but they will regrow in spring again.[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Fixed that the GMCM option for mushroom tree 'Seed On Shake' chance changed the normal tree 'Seed On Shake' chance instead. Thank you to clcdev for sending a github pull request!
Changing the setting directly through the config file was unaffected.
